tall hero ~62% width, two details tell handle + wheels story
wide hero on top, copy + two details in a bottom strip
warm light ground for black product edges
excluded_elements: decorative gradient that hides black edges

adopted_rules: details grouped on one side only

tokens.palette_note: accent comes from the job palette; --accent-ink is computed from the accent's luminance when the job does not send it

elements.text: Pull handle, wheels and stack clips, as photographed
Treaded wheels on the base unit

adaptation_rules: split (default): full-bleed close-up rail on the left (38% of W at 1:1, 37% at 4:5), tiles separated by 6px accent gaps, accent seam on the rail edge (rail_seam:false drops it)

split: tile heights water-fill the rail without passing the 1.25 upscale cap; a tile taller than tile_max_aspect (default 1.4) x its width shows the picture full-width with a blurred, darkened extension instead of slicing its sides

split: each rail tile = picture + a caption strip the picture never enters (the picture fades into the rail colour); captions title-only by default (caption_title_only:false adds the body), bottom-aligned with a short accent tab, an icon badge when the detail has an 'icon', or caption_style:'band' = solid accent tab flush to the rail's left edge, all tabs one shared width
split: all rail titles share one size: en 44px at stretch 112 -> 104 -> 96, then smaller (never below the QA secondary minimum) until every title is <=2 lines; zh 48 -> 36 on one line

split: hero contains into the right column, >=44px clear of the rail seam, centred under the copy with >=84px bottom margin and a soft contact shadow (hero_overlap>0 restores the break-over into the rail); subhead measure capped at ~680px and line-balanced

headline: two-tone (first word or headline_accent words in the accent, or explicit [[...]]); en 88/80/72 in 2 lines, else 80/72/64 in 3; zh 92 shrinking until the author's lines hold; eyebrow only with show_eyebrow

details: optional part_box [x0,y0,x1,y1] (normalised in the close-up) frames that part at ~45% of the tile; optional zoom; optional hero_box drops crops that repeat the hero (area > 40% of hero or IoU > 0.5)

ring: circular insets with centred captions; ring_layout auto picks 'cols' (insets in a column each side of a standing product, 4-6 insets) or 'rows' (above/below a product across the middle) by which leaves the product larger; headline shows when 3 or fewer insets
legacy rail / strip modes kept for old jobs
headline: en accent covers the descriptor as one unit and ends its line ('[[CANVAS LEATHER]] / TOTE BAG'); zh accents the leading descriptor (帆布皮革) and keeps the product noun dark
zh subhead: when it wraps, the break goes after the clause punctuation nearest the middle

ring rows: with <=3 insets the headline moves to a left column and the product fills the right side above the row when that is larger (57% of canvas height for the tote vs 33% before); 4:5 circles r=136
ring cols: circles r<=136 (8.8% of W), 20px column gap, so the product reaches ~65% of the canvas height; captions keep the min_margin
ring captions: en callouts in one casing (title case, small words lower)
limitations: demo_only: all photos are third-party reference images with unverified rights; original branding kept, not replaced
all copy is neutral visual description, not approved product claims
elements above are the measured layout of the main render; real layout is computed by the template rules for each job
rendered by engine/render.py with Chrome --headless=old (no visible window); SVG/PDF not produced (no verified vector path)

optional_job_fields.hero_overlap: 0 (default: hero stays >=44px clear of the rail seam, centred, >=84px off the bottom); >0 = px at 1500 the product breaks into the rail (old look)
optional_job_fields.details[].part_box: [x0,y0,x1,y1] in the close-up, normalised: split tiles centre the part; ring circles zoom so it fills ~62% of the circle
optional_job_fields.details[].icon: Tabler icon name; drawn at ~56px (2px stroke) in the accent inside an 88px dark badge above the caption (not with caption_style band)
optional_job_fields.tile_min_visible: 0.85: a tile wider than its picture keeps at least this share of the picture's height and extends its sides with a blurred copy, instead of cover-cropping parts away
optional_job_fields.ring_side_headline: true (default): ring rows with <=3 insets put the headline + subhead in a left column and the product full height on the right when that makes it >=12% larger; falls back to the top headline when the copy does not fit the column
optional_job_fields.headline_accent: en: number of leading words in the accent (default: all but the last 2 words when there are 4+, joiners like '&' kept inside, with a line break after the accent unit); zh: number of leading characters (default len-3 for 6+ characters, e.g. 帆布皮革|托特包); false = no accent
